doc.title: Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006

title: Jackie Harris's business training and start at Jazz & Heritage
summary: Harris says festival work was learned on the job; her background was oil company and food service before the New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Jackie, would you feel the same way about what — you are in a similar business. What prepares you to put on festivals and raise money for things. How do you get that preparation?

Well let me say this. You know it’s just recent that an individual that’s interested in doing this kind of work can go to school to learn it. It’s been a profession that you’ve learned on the job. Now I had my training is in business. I had worked for an oil company. I had also worked in food service. And my first job in this industry was with the New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival and what I brought in business to the festival they allowed me to learn in the music industry. And it’s been, you know, a great career. I can’t imagine doing anything else with any other group of individuals. I mean I’ve just made a decision that this is what God put me on earth to do.
